args.query: For the top 10 substance pairs by JOINT_DRIVER_WITH frequency, report co-detection across sites. For each pair, return: substance_a_name, substance_b_name, frequency, detected_sites_a (number of distinct sites where substance A had median_concentration > 0 at any time), detected_sites_b, co_detected_sites (number of distinct sites where both A and B had median_concentration > 0 at any time), jaccard (co_detected_sites divided by the number of distinct sites where A or B was detected). Order by frequency desc.

data.content:
Here are the highest-frequency co-driver pairs (via JOINT_DRIVER_WITH.frequency) and whether they’re detected at the same sites. Detection is counted as sites where a substance had median_concentration > 0 at any time.

Top co-driver pairs and their co-detection (top 5 shown)
- Methoxychlor — Terbutylazine
  - Co-driver frequency: 106
  - Detected sites: 17 (Methoxychlor), 2846 (Terbutylazine)
  - Co-detected sites: 14
  - Jaccard overlap: 0.0049 (very low)
- Cyanuric acid — Indeno(1,2,3-cd)pyrene
  - Co-driver frequency: 96
  - Detected sites: 17 (Cyanuric acid), 1144 (Indeno(1,2,3-cd)pyrene)
  - Co-detected sites: 17
  - Jaccard overlap: 0.0149 (very low)
- Endrin — Indeno(1,2,3-cd)pyrene
  - Co-driver frequency: 94
  - Detected sites: 108 (Endrin), 1144 (Indeno(1,2,3-cd)pyrene)
  - Co-detected sites: 79
  - Jaccard overlap: 0.0673 (modest)
- Carbendazim — Imidacloprid
  - Co-driver frequency: 88
  - Detected sites: 2402 (Carbendazim), 2370 (Imidacloprid)
  - Co-detected sites: 1298
  - Jaccard overlap: 0.3736 (high relative overlap)
- Benzo(b)fluoranthene — Iomeprol
  - Co-driver frequency: 88
  - Detected sites: 1262 (Benzo(b)fluoranthene), 318 (Iomeprol)
  - Co-detected sites: 78
  - Jaccard overlap: 0.0519 (low–modest)

Answer to your question
- Which pairs have the highest co-driver frequency? The top pairs are listed above; Methoxychlor–Terbutylazine ranks highest (frequency 106), followed by Cyanuric acid–Indeno(1,2,3-cd)pyrene (96), Endrin–Indeno(1,2,3-cd)pyrene (94), and ties at 88 for Carbendazim–Imidacloprid and Benzo(b)fluoranthene–Iomeprol.
- Do those substances also tend to be detected at the same sites? Mixed. Some high-frequency co-driver pairs show strong co-detection (notably Carbendazim–Imidacloprid with 1298 shared sites; Jaccard ~0.37), while others have very low co-detection relative to their detection footprints (e.g., Methoxychlor–Terbutylazine with Jaccard ~0.005, Cyanuric acid–Indeno with ~0.015). So high co-driver frequency does not universally imply frequent co-detection across sites.

How to reproduce or get the full top 10 with co-detection metrics
Use this Cypher query against the graph to get the top 10 pairs with detection overlap metrics:
MATCH (a:Substance)-[j:JOINT_DRIVER_WITH]-(b:Substance)
WITH CASE WHEN a.Name < b.Name THEN a ELSE b END AS a1,
     CASE WHEN a.Name < b.Name THEN b ELSE a END AS b1,
     j.frequency AS freq
WITH a1, b1, sum(freq) AS frequency
ORDER BY frequency DESC
LIMIT 10
CALL {
  WITH a1
  MATCH (a1)-[ma:MEASURED_AT]->(sa:Site)
  WHERE ma.median_concentration > 0
  RETURN count(DISTINCT sa) AS detected_sites_a
}
CALL {
  WITH b1
  MATCH (b1)-[mb:MEASURED_AT]->(sb:Site)
  WHERE mb.median_concentration > 0
  RETURN count(DISTINCT sb) AS detected_sites_b
}
CALL {
  WITH a1, b1
  MATCH (a1)-[ma:MEASURED_AT]->(s:Site)<-[mb:MEASURED_AT]-(b1)
  WHERE ma.median_concentration > 0 AND mb.median_concentration > 0
  RETURN count(DISTINCT s) AS co_detected_sites
}
WITH a1, b1, frequency, detected_sites_a, detected_sites_b, co_detected_sites,
     (detected_sites_a + detected_sites_b - co_detected_sites) AS union_sites
RETURN a1.Name AS substance_a_name,
       b1.Name AS substance_b_name,
       frequency,
       detected_sites_a,
       detected_sites_b,
       co_detected_sites,
       CASE WHEN union_sites = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE toFloat(co_detected_sites) / toFloat(union_sites) END AS jaccard
ORDER BY frequency DESC

Notes
- Detection counts are the number of distinct sites where median_concentration > 0 at any time. Co-detected sites and Jaccard are computed accordingly.
